text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I need to make up my mind soon.
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)
The message that arrived on my smartphone was from <chrname>.

It seems they're planning to
"hold voluntary training among the members."
After checking the details, I give them my approval.

After the first "Representative Exchange Match,"
a bond among comrades began to blossom—not only between the Trainers, but between the Umamusume as well.
choice_data_list: —We're going to aim for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe together.
—Together, we're aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.text: The wall we must overcome is high. That is precisely why everyone must work together.
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)
[Sender: Satake Mei]

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "Sorry to interrupt when you're busy. There is something I need to tell you all once again."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "After the second Representative Exchange Race, I will select four of you to represent Japan."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...These four are the ones running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
(Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Only four people?
Out of all of us...?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You were prepared for this, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is the pinnacle of racing. It's not just Japan—contenders from all over the world are aiming for the top."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Squeezing into the starting lineup ain't easy either.
We should focus on quality over quantity.
choice_data_list: ...That's why we're entering an Uma Musume who can win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Even without narrowing it down to just the elite,
until race registration, everyone here could—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no way an Umamusume who wasn't chosen here
could ever take the title of number one in the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...We ain't going there
just to make memories.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if we cooperate as a team,
it's so that we can become stronger ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them,
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"The announcement is scheduled immediately following
the conclusion of Race 2 of the Representative Exchange Matches."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Even if someone isn't chosen as a representative, I will arrange it so that anyone who wishes can accompany us to France.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, when selecting Japan's "representatives,"
we plan to take into account their running up through the exchange meet itself.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I want you to pour all your strength into it.

...Dozens of Umamusume
are participating in 'Project L'Arc.'

They are <chrname>'s companions.
Sharing the same ambition, dividing joys and sorrows,
and continuing to hone each other going forward.
However, only four representatives will be chosen for Japan.

No matter how deep the bond becomes.
No matter how well one understands the other's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them,
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!
...*gasp*, one more...!"
She was a member of "Project L'Arc." She had seemed reserved, but watching her throw herself into training now, there was a desperate intensity to her.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...! H-Hello there, thank you for your hard work.
Thank you for all your support with Project L'Arc.
choice_data_list: Thanks as always. You're working really hard, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: “...At the very least, I felt I had to do everything within my power.”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Watching races is actually a hobby of mine.
I tune in for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe every year, too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is... a towering wall. We must analyze it, get into peak condition, and train relentlessly to handle the heavy turf—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For nearly half a century, dozens of Umamusume
representing Japan have stood at Longchamp.
Yet, even so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Still, it falls short.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That is... the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Just thinking about it makes my heart race with impatience.

Even with such a deep understanding of the height of that wall,
the reason she joined Project L'Arc was, after all—
choice_data_list: You really wish for a victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe that much, huh.
You really wish for a victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe that much, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
Every time I watch the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, I feel it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Elite racers gathered from all across the world
thunder across the turf of Longchamp.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Truly, breathtaking...!
And the crown seized through that frantic clash of fiery passions
is one of a kind—

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text: Incroyable! Wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Young Chrono
text_block_list.text: —“Special”...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...
Which is precisely why it brought me such heartache and sorrow
to see Japanese Umamusume wither and fall away.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I was surprised when the idea of Project L'Arc
was brought up, but it also felt inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Conquering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe carries so much longing—and represents a monumental leap forward in blazing a new path through history."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why... without fail, we must see this major project through to completion."
choice_data_list: ...So it was that resolve that kept you running, huh?
...So it was that resolve that kept you running, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, n-no!
I-If possible, I'd like to do it myself, or rather...
I just don't have much confidence..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
I got a little too carried away talking about it."
"Chrono Genesis—even as a fellow racing fan, she was a formidable rival with a fierce desire to conquer the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."
